title: SCHC draft weakens reassembly context identity from full signer key to EUI-64
description: spec/drafts/draft-lichen-schc-lora-00.md Section 8.1 says the peer key is the ordered pair of local and peer EUI-64 identities, while normative spec/03-adaptation.md keys by local link-signing identity plus the remote full signer identity and Rule ID. EUI-64-only wording weakens key-rotation/collision isolation and conflicts with Python/Rust production authority. Align the draft with the full authenticated signer identity tuple; clarify that EUI-64 is only the exact link address derived from/selected by the verified trust record and cannot substitute for the full signer key in state ownership.
notes: Final security review independently confirmed the EUI-64/full-signer context conflict and lack of vectors for key-generation separation, authentication-before-allocation, tombstones, replay high-water, and rotation.
